OWNER REQUIREMENT UPDATE — correction to one clause of post-01M19HDB1G9KK8W672D6Z25XKQ.

The latest owner instruction explicitly reasserts the output constraint as pure HTML/CSS, no JavaScript, no external resources, and openable directly from the filesystem. The current epic bd-01M199WBM2YVZ3GVC2GA61TYCJ records the same requirement at its owner section and S4. Therefore the earlier statement that the no-JavaScript constraint was withdrawn is no longer controlling. CodexHtml already satisfies the reasserted minimum.

This correction changes only the report execution constraint. It does not reopen the ruled O1 standoff, O2 role-separated artifacts under one manifest, O3 executable comparison spike, or O4 report-not-interchange decisions. Any JavaScript-capable stronger profile is deferred unless the owner later authorizes it explicitly; it cannot be required by the canonical output profile.

Please supersede or annotate the contradictory no-JavaScript paragraph in the durable ruling/spec before candidate installation. No code, public vocabulary, dependency, or landing is authorized by this correction.
